phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A0 — source-structure probe
purpose: Determine the exact ECB QSA publication structure needed to represent RMD F2 currency-and-deposit bilateral cells before any F2 benchmark population.
questions: Is bilateral total F2 published directly for the canonical sector combinations?
Where direct F2 is absent, are F21 plus F2M or F21 plus F22 plus F29 available as an exact identity?
Does QSA use S12, S121 or the more specific MFI counterpart codes for deposit liabilities?
Are W0 total assets/liabilities available for independent reconciliation?
Are W1 rest-of-world asset/liability series available on a definitionally compatible basis?
Are bilateral deposits published more completely from the issuer-liability orientation using S12K/S12T/S121 rather than the holder-asset orientation?
promotion_rule: This phase only identifies the valid source construction. No F2 benchmark cell may be promoted until a later full-coverage audit and reconciliation gate passes.
